description: This file defines an interface for the Loans Point In Time API within the Fineract project, providing method signatures for retrieving loan data at specific points in time, either by loan ID or external ID, and for retrieving multiple loans' data via request objects.

classes.name: LoansPointInTimeApi
classes.description: Interface defining methods to retrieve loan data at specific points in time.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPointInTime
methods.description: Retrieves loan data for a given loan ID at a specific date, formatted according to the provided date format and locale.

methods.name: retrieveLoanPointInTimeByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves loan data using an external loan ID at a specific date, with formatting for date and locale.

methods.name: retrieveLoansPointInTime
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loan data for multiple loans based on the provided request object.

methods.name: retrieveLoansPointInTimeByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieves a list of loan data for multiple loans identified by external IDs, based on the provided request object.
